glossary_subtitle: Every indicator has one definition, used everywhere: reports, the report builder, exports, the API, Power BI and the daily history.
glossary_modules_note: Indicators that belong to a module switched off for your organisation are not listed.
glossary_no_list: No page lists these people yet.
common_population: Population: active employees within your clearance. Leavers, erased people and cancelled hires are never counted. The sites add up to the total; people without a site form a « No site » row.
common_unmeasured: Not measured: an absence of measurement is never shown as a result (never 0 %, never « 0 of 0 »). An indicator with nothing to divide by says « Not measured yet ».
common_small_n: Small groups: below 5 people no percentage is shown, only the counts (« 2 of 3 »).
common_requirements: Required skills: always the full set of requirements the department defined for the role; nothing is sampled or trimmed.
common_bands: Status: Compliant from {{threshold}} %, Watch from 50 %, At risk below 50 %, unless the indicator has its own rule. {{threshold}} % is the readiness threshold of the settings.
common_freshness: Freshness: « Live » is computed when you open the page; « Daily history » comes from the snapshot taken every day.
common_delta: Change: compared with the snapshot of about a month earlier, and only between snapshots computed with the same definition; absent when there is none, never « +0 ».
common_drill: Detail: each figure is the length of an exact list of people or items; where a page lists them, the definition links to it.
common_modules: Modules: an indicator that belongs to a module switched off is not shown at all; it never appears as « Not measured ».
owner_training: Training manager or local HR administrator
owner_hr_director_hse: HR director and health and safety manager
state_no_requirement: No requirement defined for the role
steps_not_tracked: Steps not tracked for this campaign
k14_not_captured: Role start dates are recorded from this version onwards, at each role change and for each joiner; people already in post have none, and no date is ever assumed. Until someone with a recorded start date has reached « Ready », this indicator is not measured.
k1_def: Share of the people with a verdict who meet the requirements of their role.
k1_formula: Ready ÷ (Ready + Not ready). « Ready » = every requirement assessed, readiness at or above the threshold and every critical skill met. « Not ready » = fully assessed and below, or an assessed critical skill not met.
k1_incl: « Partially assessed » and « Not assessed » are shown beside the rate as counts, never inside it. Always printed with « of N assessed · coverage Y % ».
k1_bands: Compliant from the threshold · Watch from 50 · At risk below 50.
k2_def: Mean readiness, in points, of the people with at least one assessed requirement.
k2_formula: Mean of ( Σ min(level reached, level required) ÷ Σ level required ) over each person's assessed requirements.
k2_den: People with at least one assessed requirement.
k2_incl: A requirement never assessed is not a zero: it is left out of the mean and counted in the coverage.
k3_def: Share of the expected evidence that exists.
k3_formula: Σ assessed requirements (person × requirement) ÷ Σ expected requirements (person × requirement).
k3_den: The full set of requirements of the roles of the population.
k3_incl: No requirement is sampled or dropped.
k3_bands: Compliant from the threshold · Watch from 50 · below 50 « Insufficient coverage » (amber, never red).
k4_def: Of the critical requirements already assessed, the share that is met.
k4_formula: Critical requirements met ÷ critical requirements assessed. « Not demonstrated » (never assessed) is a separate count.
k4_incl: Only the « critical » flag of the requirement counts. The percentage is rounded down, so a single shortfall never reads 100 %.
k4_bands: Compliant = 100 · Watch from 95 · At risk below 95.
k5_def: Share of the critical roles with at least one successor ready now.
k5_formula: Critical roles with at least one « Ready » successor for that role ÷ critical roles.
k5_den: Roles with a criticality of 4 or more held by at least one person in scope.
k5_incl: A successor is active, named on a live succession plan and is not the incumbent. « Ready » is the role-ready rule applied to the target role.
k5_bands: Compliant from the threshold · Watch from 50 · At risk below 50.
k6_name: Critical roles without a ready successor
k6_def: Number of critical roles with no successor ready now, with the list of these roles.
k6_formula: Critical roles − critical roles with a ready successor.
k6_incl: As bench strength. No critical role designated: « To be set up », never a green 0.
k6_bands: 0 Compliant · 1 to 2 Watch · 3 or more At risk.
k7_def: Critical skills held at the required level by exactly one active person in a site.
k7_formula: Number of (site × critical skill) pairs with a single holder.
k7_incl: A holder is a person whose role requires the skill, assessed at or above the required level, certificate not lapsed. Holders are counted within your scope only.
k7_bands: 0 Compliant · 1 to 3 Watch · more than 3 At risk.
k8_name: Certifications expired or expiring within 90 days
k8_def: Two counts shown together: the people with a required certification expired, and the people with a required certification expiring within 90 days.
k8_formula: Expired = valid until before today; expiring = valid until between today and today + 90 days (the « within 30 days » figure is a subset).
k8_den: — (counts of people; the number of certificates is also given)
k8_incl: Only the certifications required by the person's role or by a safety rule. Nothing required: « No certification configured », never 0. A required certificate never recorded is counted apart.
k8_bands: Expired: 0 Compliant, 1 or more At risk; nothing expired but a required certificate missing: Watch. Expiring within 90 days: for information.
k9_def: Share of the people on a role with blocking safety requirements who meet all of them today.
k9_formula: People meeting all their blocking requirements ÷ people concerned whose requirements are evidenced. « Not demonstrated » is a separate count. A running waiver is not fitness.
k9_den: People on a role with at least one blocking safety requirement whose requirements are evidenced, met or not; a known shortfall is always counted.
k9_incl: No role concerned: « No safety requirement configured ». Rules in observe mode do not block. The percentage is rounded down.
k9_bands: Compliant = 100 · Watch from 95 · At risk below 95.
k11_def: The funnel of each campaign in progress: invited, started, submitted, validated.
k11_formula: Validated ÷ invited. A campaign is in progress while it is open and its window contains today, or while its reviews are running (locked); several campaigns are shown separately, never added up.
k11_incl: No campaign: « No campaign in progress », never 0 %. Approved assessments that belong to another campaign are counted apart.
k11_bands: Time-aware: validated at least the elapsed share of the window Compliant; more than 20 points behind At risk.
k12_def: Mean gap between the level people give themselves and the validated level.
k12_formula: Mean of (self level − validated level) over the pairs where both exist, and the share of gaps of 2 levels or more.
k12_incl: Only official levels that a reviewer or evidence validated; a level coming from the self-assessment alone is never a validated level.
k12_bands: |mean| up to 0.3 Compliant · up to 0.7 Watch · above 0.7 At risk.
k13_def: Did development actions move the skill they targeted?
k13_formula: People whose targeted skill rose by at least one validated level within 180 days of the action ÷ people who completed such an action.
k13_den: People with a completed action targeting a skill that had a measured level before.
k13_incl: A first measurement is never an uplift. People whose 180 days are still running are counted apart.
k14_def: Median number of days from taking up a role to the first « Ready » status.
k14_formula: Median of (date of the first « Ready » − role start date).
k14_den: People with a recorded role start date who reached « Ready »; at least 5.
k14_incl: No start date is ever assumed.
k15_def: Number of validated level increases over the last 90 days.
k15_formula: Number of (person, skill) pairs whose last validated level of the period is above the level held when the period opened.
k15_incl: A first measurement is never a level increase, and a self-assessment is not a validation. No assessment in the period: « Not measured yet ».
k16_def: Counts of the active development plans and, when the development module is on, of the performance improvement plans and coaching plans.
k16_formula: Plans neither draft nor finished (completed, closed, cancelled, withdrawn, rejected, archived); of which « Overdue » = due date passed.
k16_incl: Performance improvement plans are counted only for the people allowed to see them.
